metaDescription: JK 027 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: JK 027 is a registered sweet potato variety, also sold or known as LSU Light Orange or NSIC Sp 30. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2004 as NSIC 2004 Sp 30. Its record notes 13.42 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 13.42 t/ha trails the average of its group, 15.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its roots have yellow orange flesh and brownish orange skin. Dry matter is 31.71 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 19.27 percent.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** 13.42 t/ha in registry trials, 6.95 t/ha in a 2025 biofertilizer trial.
**Fruit:** Brownish orange skin, yellow orange flesh, elliptical roots, dry matter about 31.7 percent.
**Where:** Plains and hilly areas with fair soil fertility and moisture.
Low yield and dry matter in off season Cordillera trials.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: a widely tested orange fleshed table variety, Cordillera trials found it ate well though it yielded low there off season. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant JK 027 sweet potato
Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: Is LSU Light Orange the same as JK 027?
items.a: Yes. LSU Light Orange is another name for JK 027, registered as NSIC 2004 Sp 30. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
The record shows 13.42 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of JK 027?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
